label: Workflow Logics
description: Core actions to build the foundation of any automation flow

actionCategories.label: Queue Management
actionCategories.description: Create, retrieve, update, move, and delete work items in queues

actions.name: CreateWorkItemNode
actions.label: Create Work Item
actions.description: Creates a new work item in the specified queue.

actions.name: DeleteWorkItemNode
actions.label: Delete Work Item
actions.description: Deletes a work item permanently from the queue.

actions.name: GetNextQueueWorkItemNode
actions.label: Get Next Work Item
actions.description: Retrieves the next available work item from the selected queue based on the specified status, sorting, and filtering criteria.

actions.name: GetQueueNode
actions.label: Get Queue
actions.description: Retrieves the details of the specified queue by name, including its configuration, input and output schemas, processing statistics (pending, in progress, completed, failed, and total items), access settings, retry policies, and metadata such as creation and last modification information.

actions.name: GetQueueWorkItemsNode
actions.label: Get Work Items
actions.description: Retrieves work items from the specified queue using its identifier.

actions.name: GetWorkItemByIdNode
actions.label: Get Work Item By ID
actions.description: Retrieves the details of a work item by its unique identifier.

actions.name: RouteWorkItemNode
actions.label: Route Work Item
actions.description: Routes a work item from one queue to another.

actions.name: UpdateWorkItemNode
actions.label: Update Work Item
actions.description: Updates the fields or status of an existing work item.

actionCategories.label: Flow Control
actionCategories.description: Manage the course of the flow

actions.name: ConditionalActivity
actions.label: Router
actions.description: Use conditions to decide which direction the flow should take

actions.name: LoopActivity
actions.label: Loop
actions.description: Use this to keep doing something again and again, as long as certain conditions are met.

actions.name: BreakLoopNode
actions.label: Break Loop
actions.description: Breaks out of the current loop in the workflow execution.

actions.name: WaitNode
actions.label: Wait
actions.description: Pauses the workflow execution for a specified number of seconds.

actionCategories.label: Sub Flows
actionCategories.description: Set rules and manage the course of the flow

actions.name: CallAgentNode
actions.label: Call Agent
actions.description: Use this to call another agent within the current agent

actions.name: CallBlockNode
actions.label: Call Block
actions.description: Use to add custom block

label: Data Engineering
description: Clean, transform, aggregate, and structure your data with ease

actionCategories.label: Variables
actionCategories.description: Create and manage variables of different datatypes

actions.name: AddItemToListNode
actions.label: Add Item to List
actions.description: Adds one or more items to a list. Converts types if necessary.

actions.name: ClearListNode
actions.label: Clear List
actions.description: Removes all elements from the specified list.

actions.name: ConvertCustomObjectToJsonNode
actions.label: Convert Custom Object to JSON
actions.description: Converts a custom object into its JSON representation.

actions.name: ConvertJsonToCustomObjectNode
actions.label: Convert JSON to Custom Object
actions.description: Converts a JSON string into a strongly-typed custom object.

actions.name: CreateNewListNode
actions.label: Create New List
actions.description: Creates a new empty list to be used in other activities.

actions.name: DecreaseVariableNode
actions.label: Decrease Variable
actions.description: Decreases a numeric variable by a specified value.

actions.name: FindCommonListItemsNode
actions.label: Find Common List Items
actions.description: Finds common items between two lists and returns them as a new list.

actions.name: GenerateRandomNumberNode
actions.label: Generate Random Number
actions.description: Generates a random number or list of numbers within a specified range.

actions.name: IncreaseVariableNode
actions.label: Increase Variable
actions.description: Increases a numeric variable by a specified value.

actions.name: MergeListsNode
actions.label: Merge Lists
actions.description: Merges two lists into a new list. The original lists remain unchanged.

actions.name: ParseFragmentedJsonListNode
actions.label: Parse Fragmented JSON List
actions.description: Converts a list of JSON string fragments (e.g., from Add Item to List) into a list of proper objects.

actions.name: RemoveDuplicateItemsFromListNode
actions.label: Remove Duplicate Items From List
actions.description: Removes duplicate items from a list using case-sensitive or case-insensitive comparison.

actions.name: RemoveItemFromListNode
actions.label: Remove Item From List
actions.description: Removes an item from a list by index or value.

actions.name: RetrieveDataTableColumnIntoListNode
actions.label: Retrieve Data Table Column Into List
actions.description: Extracts data from a specified column of a data table into a list. The column can be identified by name or index.

actions.name: ReverseListNode
actions.label: Reverse List
actions.description: Reverses the order of items in a list.

actions.name: SetVariableNode
actions.label: Set Variable
actions.description: Sets the value of a named variable within the workflow context. Supports arithmetic expressions for ValueToSet.

actions.name: ShuffleListNode
actions.label: Shuffle List
actions.description: Randomly reorders the items in a list.

actions.name: SortListNode
actions.label: Sort List
actions.description: Sorts a list by one or more properties. Supports ascending or descending order.

actions.name: SubtractListsNode
actions.label: Subtract Lists
actions.description: Removes items from the first list that exist in the second list.

actions.name: TruncateNumberNode
actions.label: Truncate Number
actions.description: Gets the integral or fractional digits of a numeric value, or rounds up/down the value to a specified number of decimal places.

actionCategories.label: Text
actionCategories.description: Text manipulation and transformation.

actions.name: AddPrefixSuffixToTextNode
actions.label: Add Prefix or Suffix to Text
actions.description: Adds a prefix and/or suffix to a text value.

actions.name: AppendLineToTextNode
actions.label: Append Line to Text
actions.description: Appends a new line of text to the original text.

actions.name: ChangeTextCaseNode
actions.label: Change Text Case
actions.description: Converts the input text to the specified case format.

actions.name: ConvertBase64ToTextNode
actions.label: Convert Base64 to Text
actions.description: Converts a Base64-encoded string to plain text using the specified text encoding.

actions.name: ConvertNumberToTextNode
actions.label: Convert Number to Text
actions.description: Converts a numeric value into text with specified formatting options.

actions.name: ConvertTextToBase64Node
actions.label: Convert Text to Base64
actions.description: Encodes a plain text string into a Base64 string using the specified text encoding.

actions.name: ConvertTextToDateTimeNode
actions.label: Convert Text to DateTime
actions.description: Converts a text representation of a date and/or time value to a DateTime value.

actions.name: ConvertTextToNumberNode
actions.label: Convert Text to Number
actions.description: Converts a text representation of a number to a numeric value.

actions.name: CreateHtmlContentNode
actions.label: Create HTML Content
actions.description: Generates rich HTML content and stores it in a variable.

actions.name: CreateRandomTextNode
actions.label: Create Random Text
actions.description: Generates a text of specified length consisting of random characters.

actions.name: CropTextNode
actions.label: Crop Text
actions.description: Extracts text before, after, or between specified flags.

actions.name: EscapeTextForRegularExpressionNode
actions.label: Escape Text for Regular Expression
actions.description: Escapes a minimal set of characters for use in regular expressions by replacing them with their escape codes.

actions.name: GetSubtextNode
actions.label: Extract Substring from Text
actions.description: Retrieves a substring from the original text based on start index and length.

actions.name: JoinTextNode
actions.label: Join Text
actions.description: Converts a list into a text value by separating its items with a specified delimiter.

actions.name: NormalizeTextNode
actions.label: Normalize Text
actions.description: Normalizes a text by removing accents, collapsing whitespace, and converting the case.

actions.name: PadTextNode
actions.label: Pad Text
actions.description: Creates a fixed-length text by adding characters to the left or right of an existing text.

actions.name: ParseTextNode
actions.label: Parse Text
actions.description: Parses a text to find the first or all occurrences of a specified subtext or regular expression pattern.

actions.name: RecognizeEntitiesInTextNode
actions.label: Recognize Entities in Text
actions.description: Identifies specific entities in text, such as dates, numbers, emails, URLs, etc., across multiple languages.

actions.name: ReplaceTextNode
actions.label: Replace Text
actions.description: Replaces all occurrences of a specified subtext with another text. It can also be used with regular expressions.

actions.name: ReverseTextNode
actions.label: Reverse Text
actions.description: Reverses the order of characters in a given text string.

actions.name: SplitTextNode
actions.label: Split Text
actions.description: Creates a list containing the substrings of a text that is separated by a specified delimiter or regular expression.

actions.name: TokenizeTextNode
actions.label: Tokenize Text
actions.description: Splits text into a list of word tokens, optionally removing punctuation and stop words.

actions.name: TrimTextNode
actions.label: Trim Text
actions.description: Removes specified characters from the start, end, or both ends of a text string.

actionCategories.label: OCR
actionCategories.description: Optical character recognition from images and documents.

actions.name: ExtractTextWithOcrNode
actions.label: Extract Text with OCR
actions.description: Extracts text from an image file using Tesseract OCR engine.

actionCategories.label: JSON
actionCategories.description: Transform data to and from JSON format, including parsing, serialization, and deserialization.

actions.name: ConvertJsonArrayToDataTableNode
actions.label: Convert JSON Array to Data Table
actions.description: Converts a JSON array of objects into a data table, using the keys as columns.

actions.name: DeleteJSONNodeWithPrimaryKeyNode
actions.label: Delete JSON Node by Primary Key
actions.description: Recursively searches for an object with a matching primary key-value pair and deletes it from the structure.

actions.name: DeserializeJSONTextNode
actions.label: Deserialize JSON Text
actions.description: Parses a JSON string into a JsonNode object.

actions.name: FlattenJsonNode
actions.label: Flatten JSON
actions.description: Flattens a nested JSON structure into a single-level object whose keys represent the full path to each leaf value.

actions.name: GetJSONNodeListNode
actions.label: Find JSON Nodes by Key
actions.description: Recursively searches through a JSON structure and returns all values associated with the specified key.

actions.name: GetJSONNodeNode
actions.label: Get First JSON Node by Key
actions.description: Recursively searches through a JSON structure and returns the first value associated with the specified key.

actions.name: InsertOrUpdateJSONNodeWithPrimaryKeyNode
actions.label: Insert or Update JSON Node by Primary Key
actions.description: Searches recursively through a JSON structure to find an object where a primary key matches a given value. If found, inserts or updates a specified key-value pair.

actions.name: ReadJSONFileNode
actions.label: Read JSON File
actions.description: Reads the contents of a JSON file from the specified file path.

actions.name: SerializeJSONNode
actions.label: Serialize JSON Token
actions.description: Converts a JsonNode or object into both JSON string and JsonNode.

actions.name: WriteTextToJSONFileNode
actions.label: Write Text to JSON File
actions.description: Writes the provided content as JSON to the specified file path.

actionCategories.label: DateTime
actionCategories.description: Date and time manipulation.

actions.name: AddToDateTimeNode
actions.label: Add Time to DateTime
actions.description: Adds a specified time value to the given DateTime based on the selected time unit.

actions.name: ExtractDateTimePartsNode
actions.label: Extract DateTime Parts
actions.description: Extracts individual date and time components (year, month, day, hour, weekday, etc.) from a DateTime value.

actions.name: FormatDateTimeNode
actions.label: Format DateTime
actions.description: Formats a DateTime value into a standard or custom string format.

actions.name: GetCurrentDateTimeNode
actions.label: Get Current Date and Time
actions.description: This activity retrieves the current date and time based on the specified retrieval type and time zone.

actions.name: IsCorrectDateTimeFormatNode
actions.label: Validate DateTime Format
actions.description: Checks if the input string matches the specified date and time format.

actions.name: SubtractDatesNode
actions.label: Subtract Dates
actions.description: Computes the time difference between two DateTime values in the selected unit (Seconds, Minutes, Hours, or Days).

actionCategories.label: Database
actionCategories.description: Database operations and data access.

actions.name: CloseMsSqlConnectionNode
actions.label: Close MS SQL Connection
actions.description: Closes an open Microsoft SQL Server database connection

actions.name: ExecuteMsSqlStatementNode
actions.label: Execute MS SQL Statement
actions.description: Connect to a Microsoft SQL Server database and execute a SQL statement.

actions.name: OpenMsSqlConnectionNode
actions.label: Open MS SQL Connection
actions.description: Open a new connection to a Microsoft SQL Server database

actionCategories.label: Data Table
actionCategories.description: Manipulate and transform data tables.

actions.name: AddRecordIdNode
actions.label: Add Record ID
actions.description: Adds a sequential record ID column to a data table, starting at a configurable value with a configurable increment.

actions.name: CalculateColumnNode
actions.label: Calculate Column
actions.description: Adds a computed column to a data table by evaluating a formula expression that references other columns.

actions.name: ChangeColumnDataTypeNode
actions.label: Change Column Data Type
actions.description: Casts one or more columns of a data table to a target data type.

actions.name: ClearDataTableNode
actions.label: Clear Data Table
actions.description: Removes all rows from a data table while preserving its structure.

actions.name: ConcatenateDataTablesNode
actions.label: Concatenate Data Tables
actions.description: Stacks two data tables vertically, aligning columns by name. Missing columns are filled with null.

actions.name: ConvertDataTableToCsvTextNode
actions.label: Convert Data Table to CSV Text
actions.description: Converts a data table into a CSV (comma-separated values) text representation.

actions.name: CreateDataTableNode
actions.label: Create Data Table
actions.description: Creates a new data table. If an existing data table is provided, it will be cloned.

actions.name: CrossTabDataTableNode
actions.label: Cross Tab Data Table
actions.description: Pivots a data table so that values in a column become new columns (wide format), with an aggregation applied per group.

actions.name: DataCleansingNode
actions.label: Data Cleansing
actions.description: Cleans text columns by trimming whitespace, collapsing spaces, removing special characters, and normalizing casing.

actions.name: DeleteColumnFromDataTableNode
actions.label: Delete Column From Data Table
actions.description: Deletes a data table column at the specified column index or column name.

actions.name: DeleteDuplicateRowsFromDataTableNode
actions.label: Delete Duplicate Rows From Data Table
actions.description: Deletes all rows that are exact duplicates from the data table.

actions.name: DeleteEmptyRowsFromDataTableNode
actions.label: Delete Empty Rows From Data Table
actions.description: Deletes rows from a data table where one or more cells are empty.

actions.name: DeleteRowFromDataTableNode
actions.label: Delete Row From Data Table
actions.description: Deletes a row from a data table based on its zero-based index.

actions.name: ExtractRegexToColumnsNode
actions.label: Extract Regex to Columns
actions.description: Applies a regular expression with capture groups to a column; each capture group becomes a new column.

actions.name: FillMissingValuesNode
actions.label: Fill Missing Values
actions.description: Fills missing (null) values in a column using a constant, the previous or next value, or the group mean.

actions.name: FilterDataTableNode
actions.label: Filter Data Table
actions.description: Filters the data table rows based on the applied rules.

actions.name: FindAndReplaceInDataTableNode
actions.label: Find or Replace in Data Table
actions.description: Finds and/or replaces data table values.

actions.name: InsertColumnIntoDataTableNode
actions.label: Insert Column Into Data Table
actions.description: Inserts a new column into the data table either at the end or before a specific column index.

actions.name: InsertRowIntoDataTableNode
actions.label: Insert Row Into Data Table
actions.description: Inserts a new row into the data table at the specified location.

actions.name: JoinDataTablesNode
actions.label: Join Data Tables
actions.description: Joins two data tables based on the specified join rule.

actions.name: MapColumnValuesNode
actions.label: Map Column Values
actions.description: Replaces values in a column using a lookup dictionary of 'from:to' pairs.

actions.name: MergeDataTablesNode
actions.label: Merge Data Tables
actions.description: Merges two data tables together, specifying the merging behavior in case their columns are different.

actions.name: MultiRowFormulaNode
actions.label: Multi-Row Formula
actions.description: Computes a new column by referencing rows before or after the current row, e.g., running totals or moving averages.

actions.name: ProfileDataTableNode
actions.label: Profile Data Table
actions.description: Generates a data-quality summary per column, including row count, null count, distinct count, and min/max values.

actions.name: ReadFromCsvTextNode
actions.label: Read From CSV Text
actions.description: Generates a data table from a CSV text.

actions.name: RenameColumnsNode
actions.label: Rename Columns
actions.description: Renames one or more columns of a data table using a list of 'oldName:newName' pairs.

actions.name: RoundNumbersInColumnNode
actions.label: Round Numbers in Column
actions.description: Rounds the numeric values of a column to a fixed number of decimal places, significant digits, or to whole numbers.

actions.name: SampleDataTableNode
actions.label: Sample Data Table
actions.description: Returns a subset of rows from a data table, selected by count or percentage.

actions.name: SelectColumnsNode
actions.label: Select Columns
actions.description: Keeps only the specified columns of a data table, preserving their order.

actions.name: SortDataTableNode
actions.label: Sort Data Table
actions.description: Sorts the data table rows in ascending or descending order by the specified column.

actions.name: SplitTextToColumnsNode
actions.label: Split Text to Columns
actions.description: Splits the values of a single text column into multiple columns using a delimiter or fixed-length chunks.

actions.name: SummarizeDataTableNode
actions.label: Summarize Data Table
actions.description: Groups rows by one or more columns and applies aggregation functions such as Sum, Count, Minimum, Maximum, or Average.

actions.name: TransposeDataTableNode
actions.label: Transpose Data Table
actions.description: Rotates a data table so that columns become rows (long format). Optionally groups data by key columns.

actions.name: UniqueRowsByKeyNode
actions.label: Unique Rows by Key
actions.description: Removes rows that share the same value in one or more key columns, keeping either the first or last occurrence.

actions.name: UpdateDataTableItemNode
actions.label: Update Data Table Item
actions.description: Updates a specific cell in a DataTable by specifying the column, row, and new value.

actionCategories.label: Cryptography
actionCategories.description: Encrypt, decrypt, and hash data.

actions.name: DecryptTextWithAesNode
actions.label: Decrypt Text with AES
actions.description: Decrypts a Base64-encoded string using AES with optional key hashing for short keys.

actions.name: DecryptToFileWithAesNode
actions.label: Decrypt to File with AES
actions.description: Decrypts an encrypted file using AES. Supports Base64, Hex, and UTF8-encoded inputs.

actions.name: EncryptFromFileWithAesNode
actions.label: Encrypt from File with AES
actions.description: Encrypts the contents of a file using AES. Supports Base64, Hex encoding for output.

actions.name: EncryptTextWithAesNode
actions.label: Encrypt Text with AES
actions.description: Encrypts a string using AES encryption. Short keys are hashed securely to 32 bytes.

actions.name: HashFromFileNode
actions.label: Hash from File
actions.description: Hash the contents of a file, using a specified algorithm

actions.name: HashFromFileWithKeyNode
actions.label: Hash from File with Key
actions.description: Hash the contents of a file with a key, using a specified algorithm

actions.name: HashTextNode
actions.label: Hash Text
actions.description: Hash a string, using a specified algorithm

actions.name: HashTextWithKeyNode
actions.label: Hash Text with Key
actions.description: Hash a string with a key, using a specified algorithm

actionCategories.label: Aggregation
actionCategories.description: Group, summarize, and compute statistics across data table rows.

actions.name: CountRowsPerGroupNode
actions.label: Count Rows Per Group
actions.description: Adds a column with the number of rows in each group, optionally counting distinct values of a column. If no group columns are given, a single count is produced for the whole table.

actions.name: GeometricMeanNode
actions.label: Geometric Mean
actions.description: Adds a column containing the geometric mean of a numeric column per group (or the whole table if no group columns are given).

actions.name: GroupByNode
actions.label: Group By
actions.description: Groups rows by one or more columns and applies multiple aggregation functions to one or more value columns. Aggregations are specified as JSON, e.g. [{"Column":"Sales","Aggregation":"Sum","Result":"TotalSales"}].

actions.name: HarmonicMeanNode
actions.label: Harmonic Mean
actions.description: Adds a column containing the harmonic mean of a numeric column per group (or the whole table if no group columns are given).

actions.name: KurtosisNode
actions.label: Kurtosis
actions.description: Adds a column containing the sample excess kurtosis of a numeric column per group (or the whole table if no group columns are given).

actions.name: ModeNode
actions.label: Mode
actions.description: Adds a column containing the most frequently occurring value of the specified column per group (or the whole table if no group columns are given).

actions.name: PercentileNode
actions.label: Percentile
actions.description: Adds a column containing the N-th percentile of the specified column per group (or the whole table if no group columns are given).

actions.name: PopulationStandardDeviationNode
actions.label: Population Standard Deviation
actions.description: Adds a column containing the population standard deviation of a numeric column per group (or the whole table if no group columns are given).

actions.name: PopulationVarianceNode
actions.label: Population Variance
actions.description: Adds a column containing the population variance of a numeric column per group (or the whole table if no group columns are given).

actions.name: SampleVarianceNode
actions.label: Sample Variance
actions.description: Adds a column containing the sample variance of a numeric column per group (or the whole table if no group columns are given).

actions.name: SkewnessNode
actions.label: Skewness
actions.description: Adds a column containing the sample skewness of a numeric column per group (or the whole table if no group columns are given).

actions.name: WeightedAverageNode
actions.label: Weighted Average
actions.description: Adds a column containing the weighted average of a value column, using a separate weights column. Results can be per group or whole-table.

actionCategories.label: Windowing
actionCategories.description: Compute row-wise, running, and sliding-window analytics over ordered data.

actions.name: BottomNByGroupNode
actions.label: Bottom N By Group
actions.description: Filters the data table to keep only the bottom N rows (by an ordering column) within each group.

actions.name: CumulativeSumNode
actions.label: Cumulative Sum
actions.description: Adds a column with the running total of a numeric column. The running total restarts for each partition.

actions.name: FirstValueByGroupNode
actions.label: First Value By Group
actions.description: Adds a column with the first (top) value of a source column within each group. Optionally order groups by an ordering column.

actions.name: LagNode
actions.label: Lag
actions.description: Adds a column with the value of a source column from a row that is offset rows earlier within each partition. Rows without an earlier row get the default value.

actions.name: LastValueByGroupNode
actions.label: Last Value By Group
actions.description: Adds a column with the last (bottom) value of a source column within each group. Optionally order groups by an ordering column.

actions.name: LeadNode
actions.label: Lead
actions.description: Adds a column with the value of a source column from a row that is offset rows later within each partition. Rows without a later row get the default value.

actions.name: MovingAverageNode
actions.label: Moving Average
actions.description: Adds a column with the moving (sliding-window) average of a numeric column. The window restarts for each partition.

actions.name: MovingSumNode
actions.label: Moving Sum
actions.description: Adds a column with the moving (sliding-window) sum of a numeric column. The window restarts for each partition.

actions.name: PercentRankNode
actions.label: Percent Rank
actions.description: Adds a column with the relative rank (0 to 1) of each row within a partition, based on an ordering column.

actions.name: RankRowsNode
actions.label: Rank Rows
actions.description: Adds a column with the rank of rows within partitions based on an ordering column. Supports ascending/descending order and dense or standard ranking.

actions.name: RowNumberNode
actions.label: Row Number
actions.description: Adds a column with a sequential row number. If partition columns are given, the numbering restarts at 1 for each partition.

actions.name: RunningAverageNode
actions.label: Running Average
actions.description: Adds a column with the cumulative mean of a numeric column. The running average restarts for each partition.

actions.name: TopNByGroupNode
actions.label: Top N By Group
actions.description: Filters the data table to keep only the top N rows (by an ordering column) within each group.

actionCategories.label: Shaping
actionCategories.description: Reshape, reorder, split, and combine rows and columns.

actions.name: AddConstantColumnNode
actions.label: Add Constant Column
actions.description: Adds a new column populated with a constant value on every row. Useful for labelling, filtering, or adding static metadata columns.

actions.name: CollapseRowsToDelimitedNode
actions.label: Collapse Rows to Delimited
actions.description: Groups rows and concatenates the values of a target column into a single delimited string per group, producing one row per group.

actions.name: CombineColumnsNode
actions.label: Combine Columns
actions.description: Merges the values of multiple columns into a single column, separated by a delimiter. The original columns can be removed or kept.

actions.name: ConditionalSplitNode
actions.label: Conditional Split
actions.description: Routes each row of a data table into one of several output data tables based on a semicolon-separated list of DataTable row filter expressions. The first matching condition wins per row; rows matching no condition go to a default output.

actions.name: CopyColumnNode
actions.label: Copy Column
actions.description: Duplicates an existing column into a new column with the same values. If the target column already exists, it is overwritten.

actions.name: ExpandDelimitedCellToRowsNode
actions.label: Expand Delimited Cell to Rows
actions.description: Explodes cells of a target column by a delimiter, producing one row per delimited value. Other columns are replicated across the expanded rows.

actions.name: MoveColumnsNode
actions.label: Move Columns
actions.description: Reorders columns in a data table. Specify the desired column order as a comma-separated list; any columns not listed are appended at the end in their original order.

actions.name: StackColumnsNode
actions.label: Stack Columns
actions.description: Stacks the values of multiple columns vertically into a single column. Each source column's values become additional rows, keeping the remaining (identifier) columns. Optionally adds a source column name column.

actions.name: UnpivotNode
actions.label: Unpivot
actions.description: Melts a wide data table into a long format. Designated value columns are turned into two columns: one holding the column name and one holding the value, with the remaining columns kept per row.

actionCategories.label: Encoding
actionCategories.description: Encode, scale, and bin categorical and numeric values for analysis.

actions.name: BinValuesNode
actions.label: Bin Values
actions.description: Bins numeric values into equal-width buckets. Adds a column containing the bin label (e.g. '1', '2') and optionally the lower bound of each bin.

actions.name: LabelEncodeNode
actions.label: Label Encode
actions.description: Converts a categorical column into integer labels (0-based). Distinct values are assigned integers sorted alphabetically. Optionally replaces the source column or adds a new column.

actions.name: MinMaxScaleNode
actions.label: Min-Max Scale
actions.description: Scales the values of one or more numeric columns to a target range (default 0 to 1) using the global min/max of each column.

actions.name: OneHotEncodeNode
actions.label: One-Hot Encode
actions.description: Creates one new binary (0/1) column for each distinct value in the source column. Optionally drops the original column. Produces one row per distinct value unless a single row is selected for the whole table.

actions.name: QuantileBinNode
actions.label: Quantile Bin
actions.description: Bins numeric values into equal-frequency quantile buckets based on the sorted values. Each bin contains roughly the same number of values.

actions.name: ZScoreStandardizeNode
actions.label: Z-Score Standardize
actions.description: Standardizes one or more numeric columns to have zero mean and unit variance (sample standard deviation) using each column's global statistics.

actionCategories.label: Data Quality
actionCategories.description: Clean, impute, and detect anomalies to improve data quality.

actions.name: DetectOutliersNode
actions.label: Detect Outliers
actions.description: Adds a boolean column flagging numeric outliers in a value column using the IQR or Z-score method. Computed per optional group columns.

actions.name: FuzzyMatchNode
actions.label: Fuzzy Match
actions.description: Matches rows between a primary data table and a reference data table using fuzzy string similarity on one column each. Outputs the primary rows enriched with the matched reference columns, plus the similarity score.

actions.name: ImputeByMeanNode
actions.label: Impute by Mean
actions.description: Replaces missing (null) values in one or more numeric columns with the arithmetic mean of each column. Computed per optional group columns.

actions.name: ImputeByMedianNode
actions.label: Impute by Median
actions.description: Replaces missing (null) values in one or more numeric columns with the median of each column. Computed per optional group columns.

actions.name: ImputeByModeNode
actions.label: Impute by Mode
